verdict.rationale: Calendly can be driven without its UI through its own REST API v2. Personal access tokens give non-interactive auth suited to scripts, webhook subscriptions trigger automations, and a sandbox environment exists for testing, which together support unattended, API-driven automation. However, the evidence shows no CLI, no headless runner and no CI-specific guidance, so 'run in CI' is only possible by scripting raw API calls. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless client, documented CI/CD integration or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Programmatically book meetings and read and write Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker data.
The Calendly API v2 is REST-based and has predictable resource-oriented URLs.
Use a personal access token to authenticate an internal or private application with the Calendly API v2.
Subscribe to Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker events to run automations the moment they happen.
select **Sandbox** for development and testing, or **Production** when your app is ready for real users.
Developers can make GET and POST requests to API endpoints on behalf of a Calendly user on any subscription plan, including the Free plan
